 by Alex Sarwar · 11 November 2026 at 6:51 pm

 Post 
 Share

 Top of the table Kathmandu Gorkhas faces Sudurpaschim Royals in this latest league stage contest in the Nepal Premier League. 
 Date & time: 
 13 November 2026 at 6:45 am 
 Venue: Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur, Nepal
 Weather: Mostly dry, with temperatures peaking at around 18c.
 How to watch: UK – NETTV App / USA – NETTV App / Nepal – Himalaya Sports Network and NETTV App
 Will Kathmandu Gorkhas finish top of the NPL league stage come its conclusion?
 Open poll and results 
 Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Sudurpaschim Royals prediction 
 Kathmandu Gorkhas have the longest winning streak of this season’s NPL so far. They’ve been victorious in each of their last four matches, and that run has taken them to the summit of the table at the time of writing.
 Surdurpaschim Royals have been in excellent form themselves, recording three straight wins over Chitwan Rhinos, Karnali Yaks and Janakpur Bolts respectively. However, Kathmandu have been powering along like a freight train lately, and it’s difficult to see them being stopped.
 They appear to have found the perfect blend of domestic and overseas talent. David Warner is undoubtedly the star, but local players have also made telling contributions, with Rashid Khan scoring a crucial half century last time out. Their consistency has been remarkable, and momentum is with them.
 In what should be a thrilling encounter, consider backing Kathmandu to extend their winning run to five heading into the home stretch of this tournament.
 Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Sudurpaschim Royals tip: Kathmandu Gorkhas to win
